answer_1.quote: In this paper, we propose prefix-tuning, a lightweight alternative to fine-tuning for natural language generation (NLG) tasks, inspired by prompting.
answer_1.outputs: textual descriptions of data tables and abstractive summaries of news articles

answer_2.quote: For evaluation, we report the metrics using the official evaluation scripts (see details in Appendix A.1). For the summarization task, we use the XSUM dataset, which is an abstractive summarization dataset on news articles. We report ROUGE-1, ROUGE-2 and ROUGE-L.
